appDescription.message: Hides the feed, ads, news and notification badges on LinkedIn so you can stay focused.
appDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the manifest and in Safari's extension settings.

appName.description: Product name. Shown as the popup document title and heading. Not translated — it is a proper noun.

popupHint.description: Explains the toggle direction: a toggle that is on hides the corresponding element.

toggleAds.description: Toggle label: promoted posts and sidebar advertisements.

toggleBadges.description: Toggle label: the red counters in the top navigation.

toggleFeed.description: Toggle label: the center column on the feed route.

toggleNews.description: Toggle label: the LinkedIn News module and the daily-games box.
